group.passage: How many girls around the world go to secondary school? One way to find out is to compare the number of girls in secondary school with the number of girls of secondary-school age. The chart below shows this figure for the world and three regions from 2000 to 2024. For the world as a whole, it rose from about 57 in 2000 to 77 in 2024. South Asia changed the most. In 2000, its figure for girls was only about 41, far below the world level. Since then, it has climbed faster than in any other region in the chart, and it reached 78 in 2024. Bangladesh, a country in South Asia, shows one way such a change can happen. In 1994, it began to pay money, called a stipend, to girls in grades 6 to 10 in country areas, and it also paid their school fees. To keep receiving the money, a girl had to attend at least 75 percent of school days, do well enough in her studies, and stay unmarried. The program also hoped to raise the age at which girls marry. A World Bank study found that the program greatly increased the number of girls in secondary school but made no clear difference for boys. Each extra year the program ran in an area meant more girls aged 11 to 18 in school there. Between 1998 and 2017, the share of Bangladeshi girls in secondary school rose from 39 percent to 67 percent. Still, the picture is not bright everywhere. In Sub-Saharan Africa, the figure for girls nearly doubled, from about 23 to 44, but it remained the lowest in the chart, while East Asia and the Pacific stayed at the top. Also, starting school is not the same as finishing it. In 2017, the dropout rate for girls in Bangladesh's secondary schools was 42 percent. Getting girls into school is only the first step; helping them stay there is the next.

figures.description: 折線圖，有四條線。橫軸是年份（2000、2005、2010、2015、2020、2024），縱軸是女生中學毛入學率（%）：中學女生人數（不論年齡）和中學學齡女生人數的比。World（世界）依序是 56.9、62.7、69.8、74.4、75.9、77.1；Sub-Saharan Africa（撒哈拉以南非洲）依序是 22.7、27.6、34.9、40.0、42.8、44.5，每一年都是四條線中最低的；South Asia（南亞）依序是 40.6、50.2、61.4、73.2、76.7、78.2；East Asia & Pacific（東亞與太平洋）依序是 60.9、70.5、85.3、88.3、90.8、92.5，每一年都是最高的。南亞在 2015 年（73.2）還低於世界（74.4），2020 年（76.7）已高於世界（75.9），2024 年（78.2）也高於世界（77.1）。

translation_zh.text:
全世界有多少女孩上中學？一個了解的方法，是把中學女生的人數和中學學齡女生的人數拿來比較。下面的圖表顯示了世界和三個地區從 2000 年到 2024 年的這個數字。就全世界來看，它從 2000 年的大約 57 上升到 2024 年的 77。
南亞的變化最大。2000 年，南亞女孩的這個數字只有大約 41，遠低於世界的水準。從那之後，它快速攀升，到 2024 年達到 78。
南亞國家孟加拉，呈現了這種改變可能發生的一種方式。1994 年，孟加拉開始發給鄉村地區六到十年級的女孩一筆稱為獎助金的錢，也替她們付學費。女孩要繼續領這筆錢，必須至少有百分之 75 的上學日到校、成績夠好，而且保持未婚。世界銀行的一項研究發現，這個計畫大幅增加了上中學的女孩人數，對男生卻沒有明顯的影響。從 1998 年到 2017 年，孟加拉女孩上中學的比率從百分之 39 升到百分之 67。
不過，並不是每個地方的情況都樂觀。在撒哈拉以南非洲，女孩的這個數字幾乎翻倍，從大約 23 升到 44，但仍是圖中最低的，而東亞與太平洋地區一直位居最高。此外，開始上學不等於讀完。2017 年，孟加拉中學女生的輟學率是百分之 42。讓女孩走進教室只是第一步，幫助她們留下來才是下一步。
